name: create-nuxt-base
description: Nuxt 4 starter template (nuxt-base-template/) for lenne.Tech projects, scaffolded by the lt CLI (lt frontend nuxt / lt fullstack init).
author: lenne.Tech GmbH

scripts.check: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm audit && pnpm peers check && pnpm run check:ci-placement && pnpm run test:scripts && pnpm run format:check && cd nuxt-base-template && pnpm run check
scripts.check:fix: pnpm install && pnpm audit --fix && pnpm peers check && pnpm run check:ci-placement && pnpm run test:scripts && pnpm run format && cd nuxt-base-template && pnpm run check:fix
scripts.check:naf: pnpm install && pnpm peers check && pnpm run check:ci-placement && pnpm run test:scripts && pnpm run format && cd nuxt-base-template && pnpm run check:naf
scripts.test:scripts: node --test scripts/check-ci-placement.test.mjs scripts/root-workspace.test.mjs scripts/next-guides.test.mjs scripts/starter-version.test.mjs scripts/template-defaults.test.mjs
